name: Ookouchi Satomi
source:
Cheerful and upbeat, Satomi is defined as the “mood maker” of her unit. She is the communications and computer operator of the group, providing detailed intelligence vital to mission success. Ironically she doesn’t seem to have a talent at long term memorization, and can be forgetful at times.

Hobby: Strap collecting
Talent: Braille reading
Likes: Milk
Dislikes: Tobacco

[From Nargrakhan's [url=http://web.archive.org/web/20070210175407/http://www.elizar.com/?p=16]review[/url]]
